description: This file defines a React functional component 'OldModelDashboard' which manages and displays a comprehensive model management dashboard. It includes features such as model listing, filtering, editing, adding models, viewing metrics, health checks, retry policies, and related UI components. It heavily interacts with external APIs via imported functions and manages complex state for various dashboard functionalities.

methods.name: formatCreatedAt
methods.description: Formats a timestamp string into a locale date string, or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: handleEditClick
methods.description: Sets the selected model for editing and makes the modal visible.

methods.name: handleEditCancel
methods.description: Closes the model edit modal and clears the selected model.

methods.name: uploadProps
methods.description: Defines props for file upload handling, including validation, before upload processing, and change handling, with notifications upon success or failure.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Updates the 'lastRefreshed' timestamp to trigger data refresh.

methods.name: handleSaveRetrySettings
methods.description: Saves retry policy settings via API based on current selected model group or global selection.

methods.name: runHealthCheck
methods.description: Executes a health check API call and updates the response state for display.
